key: HARDY: I'mma be real, even just standing here feels wrong.
en: HARDY: I'mma be real, even just standing here feels wrong.
ja: ハーディ: 正直言って、ここに立ってるだけでも間違ってる気がするぜ。

key: I can see her, mate.
en: I can see her, mate.
ja: 彼女が見えるんだよ、相棒。

key: HARDY: My Rock Types could drop this thing right on her and end it all.
en: HARDY: My Rock Types could drop this thing right on her and end it all.
ja: ハーディ: 俺のいわタイプなら、これを彼女の上に落として全部終わらせられる。

key: I don't like this.
en: I don't like this.
ja: こんなの好きじゃない。

key: RADOMUS: You don't need to think of it like that.
en: RADOMUS: You don't need to think of it like that.
ja: ラドマス: そんな風に考える必要はない。

key: We've already made the proper arrangements with her; all we need to do is wait.
en: We've already made the proper arrangements with her; all we need to do is wait.
ja: 彼女とはすでにきちんと段取りをつけてある。あとは待つだけだ。

key: HARDY: Sirius is one thing, but I don't like hurtin' anyone.
en: HARDY: Sirius is one thing, but I don't like hurtin' anyone.
ja: ハーディ: シリウスは別として、俺は誰かを傷つけるのは好きじゃないんだ。

key: RADOMUS: Even Sirius has people who would hesitate to see him ended.
en: RADOMUS: Even Sirius has people who would hesitate to see him ended.
ja: ラドマス: シリウスにだって、彼が終わるのをためらう者がいる。

key: It may be hard to imagine, but even someone like him might once have been a dear friend to someone.
en: It may be hard to imagine, but even someone like him might once have been a dear friend to someone.
ja: 想像しづらいかもしれないが、彼のような者でさえ、かつては誰かの大切な友人だったかもしれない。

key: Even so, they have made it clear they will give us no margin for mishap.
en: Even so, they have made it clear they will give us no margin for mishap.
ja: それでも、彼らは我々に失敗の余地を与えないとはっきり示している。

key: HARDY: I know. That's why it gotta be like this, right?
en: HARDY: I know. That's why it gotta be like this, right?
ja: ハーディ: わかってる。だからこうするしかないんだよな?

key: Who knew when we're sittin' next to each other in class that it'd come to this?
en: Who knew when we're sittin' next to each other in class that it'd come to this?
ja: 教室で隣同士に座ってた頃、まさかこんなことになるなんて誰が思っただろうな。

key: RADOMUS: If we already knew all that everything would come to, it would make both journey and destination that much more meaningless.
en: RADOMUS: If we already knew all that everything would come to, it would make both journey and destination that much more meaningless.
ja: ラドマス: すべての行き着く先を最初から知っていたなら、旅も、その終着点も、意味を失ってしまうだろう。

key: HARDY: Where is she?
en: HARDY: Where is she?
ja: ハーディ: 彼女はどこだ?

key: RADOMUS: Saphira?
en: RADOMUS: Saphira?
ja: ラドマス: サファイラか?

key: Hmm.
en: Hmm.
ja: うむ。

key: It would appear that she is...
en: It would appear that she is...
ja: どうやら彼女は…

key: Right on cue.
en: Right on cue.
ja: ちょうどいいタイミングだ。

key: FERN: Sirius, you see her?
en: FERN: Sirius, you see her?
ja: ファーン: シリウス、あいつ見えてる?

key: SIRIUS: I do. Tyrantrum, intercept!
en: SIRIUS: I do. Tyrantrum, intercept!
ja: シリウス: 見えている。ガチゴラス、迎撃しろ!

key: RADOMUS: Now or never.
en: RADOMUS: Now or never.
ja: ラドマス: 今しかない。

key: HARDY: Right! Let's do this, Gigalith!
en: HARDY: Right! Let's do this, Gigalith!
ja: ハーディ: よし! やるぞ、ギガイアス!

key: HARDY: Bring the house down!
en: HARDY: Bring the house down!
ja: ハーディ: 家ごとたたき落とせ!

key: RADOMUS: Any moment now, the show shall begin.
en: RADOMUS: Any moment now, the show shall begin.
ja: ラドマス: まもなく、幕が上がる。

key: FERN: That was a warning.
en: FERN: That was a warning.
ja: ファーン: 今のは警告だから。

key: Give me reason to go again and see what happens.
en: Give me reason to go again and see what happens.
ja: もう一回やらせる理由をくれれば、どうなるか見せてあげる。

key: SIRIUS: It would seem expecting Blake to have been equal to his task was a mistake.
en: SIRIUS: It would seem expecting Blake to have been equal to his task was a mistake.
ja: シリウス: ブレイクに任を果たせると期待したのは、間違いだったようだな。

key: FERN: Thinking he was equal to anything above a sack of flour was your mistake.
en: FERN: Thinking he was equal to anything above a sack of flour was your mistake.
ja: ファーン: あいつが小麦粉の袋以上の何かだと思ってた時点で、あんたの間違いだから。

key: But don't worry-- you've got the top dog on it now.
en: But don't worry-- you've got the top dog on it now.
ja: でも心配しないで――今はナンバーワンが担当してるから。

key: Wherever \PN runs, my arrows will find him.
en: Wherever \PN runs, my arrows will find him.
ja: \PNがどこへ逃げようと、あたしの矢が見つけ出す。

key: Wherever \PN runs, my arrows will find her.
en: Wherever \PN runs, my arrows will find her.
ja: \PNがどこへ逃げようと、あたしの矢が見つけ出す。

key: Wherever \PN runs, my arrows will find them.
en: Wherever \PN runs, my arrows will find them.
ja: \PNがどこへ逃げようと、あたしの矢が見つけ出す。

key: The case is as good as closed.
en: The case is as good as closed.
ja: この件はもう終わったようなもの。

key: SIRIUS: I'm sure that will be so, if your skill is even a fraction as great as your ego.
en: SIRIUS: I'm sure that will be so, if your skill is even a fraction as great as your ego.
ja: シリウス: お前の腕前が、そのプライドの何分の一かでもあるならな。

key: FERN: Excuse me?
en: FERN: Excuse me?
ja: ファーン: は?

key: SIRIUS: Shoot first; brag later.
en: SIRIUS: Shoot first; brag later.
ja: シリウス: 自慢は撃ってからにしろ。

key: FERN: Talk to me like that again and I'll make you my target instead.
en: FERN: Talk to me like that again and I'll make you my target instead.
ja: ファーン: またそんな口きいたら、次はあんたを的にするから。

key: SIRIUS: And you're willing to answer to Lin for that?
en: SIRIUS: And you're willing to answer to Lin for that?
ja: シリウス: それでリンに申し開きするつもりか?

key: FERN: That bitch doesn't scare me.
en: FERN: That bitch doesn't scare me.
ja: ファーン: あの女なんか怖くないし。

key: I'll take down anyone who gets in my way.
en: I'll take down anyone who gets in my way.
ja: 邪魔する奴は誰だろうとたたき潰す。

key: Luckily for you, \PN happens to be much more of an obstacle than you could ever dream of being.
en: Luckily for you, \PN happens to be much more of an obstacle than you could ever dream of being.
ja: あんたには運がいいことに、\PNはあんたが夢見るよりもずっと厄介な障害物だから。

key: Make sure that doesn't change.
en: Make sure that doesn't change.
ja: それが変わらないようにしなさいよ。

key: AYA: ...But...
en: AYA: ...But...
ja: アヤ: …でも…

key: But Lin said to leave them--
en: But Lin said to leave them--
ja: でもリンは放っておけって――

key: SIRIUS: What Lin said is our business; not yours.
en: SIRIUS: What Lin said is our business; not yours.
ja: シリウス: リンが何と言ったかは我々の問題だ。お前の問題ではない。

key: Her apparent fondness for \PN may well be her undoing, and I will be damned if I let everything I've worked for all this time unravel because of THAT.
en: Her apparent fondness for \PN may well be her undoing, and I will be damned if I let everything I've worked for all this time unravel because of THAT.
ja: 彼女が\PNに見せているらしい情が、彼女の破滅を招くかもしれん。だが、これまで積み上げてきたものが、そんな理由で崩れるのを見過ごすつもりは断じてない。

key: All you need to do is sit still and stay quiet.
en: All you need to do is sit still and stay quiet.
ja: お前はじっと座って、黙っていればいい。

key: You're our guarantee that they don't pull anything like they did with Blake again.
en: You're our guarantee that they don't pull anything like they did with Blake again.
ja: お前は、ブレイクの時のようなことを二度と繰り返させないための保証だ。

key: After all, they wouldn't dare harm their friend.
en: After all, they wouldn't dare harm their friend.
ja: 何しろ、友人を傷つけるような真似はしないだろうからな。

key: Life insurance needs not speak.
en: Life insurance needs not speak.
ja: 生命保険はしゃべる必要がない。

key: AYA: You're just stalling for her anyway...
en: AYA: You're just stalling for her anyway...
ja: アヤ: どうせ彼女のために時間稼ぎしてるだけでしょ…

key: SIRIUS: Perhaps I was unclear.
en: SIRIUS: Perhaps I was unclear.
ja: シリウス: 言い方が足りなかったようだな。

key: Your tongue is your greatest liability.
en: Your tongue is your greatest liability.
ja: お前の舌は、お前にとって最大の弱点だ。

key: Use it again and it will not be the only thing we relieve you of.
en: Use it again and it will not be the only thing we relieve you of.
ja: また使うようなら、次に奪うのはそれだけでは済まんぞ。

key: SIRIUS: We just need to buy her enough time to finish that PULSE machine.
en: SIRIUS: We just need to buy her enough time to finish that PULSE machine.
ja: シリウス: 我々はただ、あのPULSE装置を完成させる時間を彼女のために稼げばいい。

key: Everything will be in order soon.
en: Everything will be in order soon.
ja: すべてはすぐに片付く。

key: Until then, Fern,
en: Until then, Fern,
ja: それまでだ、ファーン、

key: Pray you hit something.
en: Pray you hit something.
ja: 何か命中することを祈るんだな。

key: FERN: Pray it isn't you.
en: FERN: Pray it isn't you.
ja: ファーン: あんたに当たらないことを祈っといて。

key: FERN: Ahahaha!
en: FERN: Ahahaha!
ja: ファーン: あはははは!

key: FERN: Oh, man, it is just too much!
en: FERN: Oh, man, it is just too much!
ja: ファーン: ああもう、笑いが止まらない!

key: I mean, I set it up, but I didn't think it would work that easily!
en: I mean, I set it up, but I didn't think it would work that easily!
ja: いや、あたしが仕掛けたんだけど、こんな簡単に引っかかると思ってなかった!

key: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped himself in!
en: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped himself in!
ja: でも見てよ、\PNってば本当に自分からわなにはまっちゃった!

key: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped herself in!
en: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped herself in!
ja: でも見てよ、\PNってば本当に自分からわなにはまっちゃった!

key: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped themselves in!
en: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped themselves in!
ja: でも見てよ、\PNってば本当に自分からわなにはまっちゃった!

key: FERN: How dumb can you get?!
en: FERN: How dumb can you get?!
ja: ファーン: どこまで馬鹿なわけ?!

key: Well, who cares?
en: Well, who cares?
ja: まあ、どうでもいいけど。

key: It'll be over in a minute anyway.
en: It'll be over in a minute anyway.
ja: どうせすぐ終わるし。

key: You've got nowhere to run now, so I hope you're ready to dance for me!
en: You've got nowhere to run now, so I hope you're ready to dance for me!
ja: もう逃げ場はないんだから、あたしのために踊る覚悟はできてるよね!

key: ???: \PN, heads up!
en: ???: \PN, heads up!
ja: ???: \PN、危ない!

key: ???: \PN, I've got you!
en: ???: \PN, I've got you!
ja: ???: \PN、任せて!

key: TITANIA: You good?
en: TITANIA: You good?
ja: ティタニア: 大丈夫?

key: VICTORIA: Are you okay?
en: VICTORIA: Are you okay?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 平気?

key: TITANIA: That wasn't exactly the smooth ride I was hoping for, but...
en: TITANIA: That wasn't exactly the smooth ride I was hoping for, but...
ja: ティタニア: 期待してたほどスムーズな乗り心地じゃなかったけど…

key: It got you out of there in one piece.
en: It got you out of there in one piece.
ja: 無事にあそこから連れ出せたわ。

key: That's more than I can say for some others.
en: That's more than I can say for some others.
ja: 他の何人かに比べれば、それだけでも上出来ね。

key: TITANIA: Looks like the only way to go is forward.
en: TITANIA: Looks like the only way to go is forward.
ja: ティタニア: 進む道は前しかなさそうね。

key: Lick your wounds and let's get a move on.
en: Lick your wounds and let's get a move on.
ja: 傷をなめるのはそこそこにして、動きましょう。

key: They may not be able to see us down here, but we're not accomplishing anything either.
en: They may not be able to see us down here, but we're not accomplishing anything either.
ja: ここにいれば見つからないだろうけど、それじゃ何も成し遂げられない。

key: Sorry for the rocky ride-- I...
en: Sorry for the rocky ride-- I...
ja: 揺れる乗り物でごめんね――わたし…

key: Panicked?
en: Panicked?
ja: パニックになってた?

key: Anyway, I don't think they can see us from here, but...
en: Anyway, I don't think they can see us from here, but...
ja: とにかく、ここからじゃ見つからないと思うけど…

key: VICTORIA: I don't think we have a way up either.
en: VICTORIA: I don't think we have a way up either.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 上に行く道もなさそうね。

key: I guess we'll have to go further down?
en: I guess we'll have to go further down?
ja: もっと下に行くしかないのかな?

key: I don't want them to have any more time to get away, but... I guess there's no choice.
en: I don't want them to have any more time to get away, but... I guess there's no choice.
ja: これ以上逃げる時間を与えたくないけど…仕方ないか。

key: Let's go.
en: Let's go.
ja: 行こう。

key: Um... I won?
en: Um... I won?
ja: えっと…わたしが勝った?

key: Oh...
en: Oh...
ja: ああ…

key: I never thought I'd make it here...
en: I never thought I'd make it here...
ja: まさかここまで来られるとは思わなかった…

key: I guess I'm not so worthless after all.
en: I guess I'm not so worthless after all.
ja: 俺も、そこまで役立たずじゃなかったってことか。

key: Listen up! The most important thing isn't power, it isn't courage, and it isn't even having friends! The only thing that matters is that you can rely on ME.
en: Listen up! The most important thing isn't power, it isn't courage, and it isn't even having friends! The only thing that matters is that you can rely on ME.
ja: よく聞け! 一番大事なのは力じゃない、勇気でもない、友達がいることですらない! 大事なのはただ一つ、俺を頼れるってことだけだ。

key: An old area map is posted here...
en: An old area map is posted here...
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている…

key: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
en: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
ja: …でも、もう正確ではないようだ。
